,COUNT(DISTINCT  IF(p.age_y >=15,p.cid,NULL)) target_all

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT p.hospcode, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,p.DISCHARGE
,c.g_chronic
,t.DATE_SERV,t.PPSPECIAL
,t.PPSPLACE,t.HOSPCODE as input_hosp
,t.PROVIDER
,t.age_y
,IF(q.2q=1,'ผล2Q ผิดปกติ','') AS 2q
,IF(q.9q=1,'ผล9Q ผิดปกติ','') AS 9q
,IF( t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270','1B0271','1B0272','1B0273')  AND q.9q=1   ,'ได้รับการประเมิน','' ) AS result
FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN (SELECT cid,GROUP_CONCAT(DIAGCODE ORDER BY DIAGCODE) g_chronic FROM t_chronic GROUP BY cid) 
  AS c ON p.cid=c.cid 
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_9q q  ON p.cid=q.cid AND q.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
LEFT JOIN tmp_labor l ON p.cid=l.cid AND l.bdate BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_8q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9)  AND ISNULL(l.cid) 
 AND p.age_y >=15
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA,d.DISCHARGE
,d.g_chronic
,d.DATE_SERV,d.PPSPECIAL
,d.PPSPLACE,d.input_hosp
,d.PROVIDER,d.age_y,d.result,d.2q,d.9q
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}
